decision.reason: [ev-3ade4dee13c7] only names a new `CancelHealthCheckOnNewRevision` feature gate in kustomize-controller. It is one line in a highlights list. The rest of that section ([ev-bd329a64ec5d], [ev-33bcdb8062c7] and the other items) says nothing more about this gate. The evidence does not give the gate's default state (opt-in or on by default), what it does when enabled, or which environments it affects. An engineer cannot write the applicability condition without at least the default and the behaviour it gates, which would come from the linked PR, the controller changelog or the feature-gate docs.
